considerations: Tune the thresholds against approved scanners, load testing and monitoring.
Burst shape can support triage, but does not establish that activity came from AI.
description: Look for five-minute bursts touching many destination hosts and ports from one source.

evidence.claim: Microsoft reported Storm-3358 using ARTEX around financial-sector intrusions, including fast network probing, password abuse and infrastructure associated with remote access tooling.

expected_output: One row per matching source IP and five-minute window.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Look for five-minute bursts touching many destination hosts and ports from one source.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Rapid Network Probing Across Ports and Hosts

1.json:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP) and DestinationPort > 0
| summarize Events = count(), Hosts = dcount(DestinationIP), Ports = dcount(DestinationPort), Actions = make_set(DeviceAction, 8) by SourceIP, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Events >= 80 and Hosts >= 5 and Ports >= 12
| order by Events desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
